description:
## Problem
Only parallel pytest sessions take the host lock (`_wants_parallel_lock`, `_benchbox_pytest_xdist_safety.py:96-102`; `_should_acquire_test_lock`, `tests/conftest.py:124-135`). The heaviest local runs are serial and take none: `test-slow`, `test-stress`, `test-correctness-gate`, `test-local-matrix`, `tpcds-obt-equivalence`, `test-required-local-cases`, `plan-capture-gate`, `test-docker-%`, `test-live-gizmosql` (Makefile:117,121,133,142,306,318,362; make/platform-tests.mk:60,103,170). UAT (`tests/uat/_cli.py`) has no lock. `pytest.ini:19` adds `-n auto` to every default run, so anything applied to `-n>0` sessions applies to every agent's targeted run and to required CI. `docs/agent/dev-loop-worktrees.md:240-244` promises `pr-preflight` never waits (tests `tests/unit/test_session_isolation.py:237,448`).

## Change
1. Lock: keep the `-n>0` rule unchanged (lock only). A serial controller session also takes the lock when the collected, selected items include a heavy marker: slow, stress, resource_heavy, live_integration, docker_integration, or any `live_*`. Decide after deselection (`pytest_collection_finish` or equivalent), before the first test. Sessions that select only live tests (`_selects_only_live_tests`, xdist plugin :121) follow the same rule.
2. Guard: admission and the watchdog run only in sessions whose selected items include a heavy marker (serial or parallel). A `-n>0` session with no heavy marker takes the lock only.
3. CI: required workflows run heavy serial suites (`ci.yml:1313` `make test-required-local-cases`). Set admission floors appropriate to hosted runners in the workflow `env:` blocks, next to `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS` (never `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`).
4. Linux guest: both `container machine run` call sites (Makefile:883 `ci-linux`, `scripts/linux_preflight_pytest.sh:66`) pass the guest an explicit `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR` on guest-local storage (e.g. `/tmp/benchbox-lock`, never under the mounted home) and guest-sized admission floors, so guest sessions serialize among themselves and never write the host holder file. The existing non-default-lock-dir warning prints in the guest; the tests/README.md update states this is expected.
5. UAT: in `tests/uat/_cli.py`, an explicit light set {preflight, gate-check, report, replay-classify, package, validate, verify-tuning-matrix, docker-cleanup}; every other subcommand (cell, sweep, stress, execute and any future one) takes the lock with admission and watchdog for its lifetime, except `--dry-run`. Inside an active isolated pytest session (`session_isolation.active()`) the dispatcher does not acquire: the session's own rule governs.
6. Env construction for UAT cell subprocesses and nested `benchbox run`/pytest preserves `BENCHBOX_TEST_SESSION_OWNER`. Call sites that build env from scratch (e.g. `tests/unit/test_standardized_test_commands.py:146-151`) pass it or a tmp lock dir.
7. Update the `tests/README.md` lock section.

## Decision gates
- D1 (resolved): serial sessions lock only with heavy markers; pr-preflight's pytest runs keep the never-wait promise.
- D2 (resolved): UAT in-process dispatch inside an isolated pytest session does not acquire.
- G1 (stop condition): list pytest invocations in `make pr-preflight` and whether any selects heavy markers serially; if one does, stop and record the conflict.
- G2 (stop condition): before merge, record admission readings from one `ubuntu-latest` and one `windows-latest` job in the PR; choose the workflow floors from them. If a hosted runner cannot pass any sane floor, stop and record.
- G3 (stop condition): measure guest RAM/disk with a trivial `CI_LINUX_CMD` before choosing guest floors; record them.

## Guardrails (all heavy-guard items)
- Linked worktree from `origin/develop` via `make worktree-create`; never the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; never `git add -A`.
- `[COMMENT-POLICY-001]`: no comments or docstrings in new code. Durations use `benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()`/`elapsed_seconds()`.
- Tests use `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR` under `tmp_path` and injected readings; never touch the real `~/.benchbox/test.lock` or depend on live host pressure, VMs or disk.
- Never delete, move or recreate a lock file from code; never stop, resize or signal processes/VMs this invocation did not start.
- Keep names `test.lock`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_SESSION_OWNER` (rename deferred on heavy-guard-status-policy).
- No automatic skip on `CI` or `BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE` (agent shells export `CI=true`).
- No heavy verification runs (no benchmark sweeps above scale 0.01, no real compose stacks) unless the item names one.

## Non-goals
`benchbox` CLI acquisition; host-side wrapping of the VM call sites; compose admission.
